question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

An eucalyptus tree in my backyard acts as a landmark for many to reach my house.

options.text: acts as a landmark for many

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the use of "An" before "eucalyptus tree". "Eucalyptus" starts with a vowel sound (the "e" sound), so the correct article to use is "A" instead of "An".
 
• The correct phrase should be "A eucalyptus tree" because the word "eucalyptus" begins with a vowel sound, not a consonant sound.
 
• Other parts of the sentence are grammatically correct and do not contain any errors.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A eucalyptus tree in my backyard acts as a landmark for many to reach my house."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "in my backyard" **– This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **Option 2: "to reach my house" **– This part of the sentence is also correct and appropriate in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "acts as a landmark for many" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not need any changes.
